plays.name: Jazz Pharmaceuticals
plays.title: Calls Bought into Earnings with Shares Back at Key Support
flow: Jazz Pharmaceuticals (JAZZ) saw 2,700 December 2026 $240 calls bought on 10/22 for about $865K, bullish flow into the November 2 earnings report.
Shares are back near the 38.2% retracement around $200. Deeper support sits at the anchored VWAP from the 2025 lows near $173. The reference price is about $205.
plays.recommendation: JAZZ is back at key support into the November 2 report, and the desk likes upside calls here for a reaction off that level.

plays.name: Casey's General Stores
plays.title: Large Put Sale Confident in High Quality Fuel/Food Business
flow: Casey's General Stores (CASY) rarely sees size flow, and on 10/27 saw 275 December 2027 $890 puts sold to open at $218.80, about $6M in premium.
CASY also has short February $520 and $500 puts in open interest from earlier sales that now carry strong mark-to-market gains.
The convenience-store operator has a strong moat with traffic-driven food growth, disciplined store expansion, and the CEFCO acquisition adding scale.
plays.recommendation: CASY is a forever-own type name, and the deep in-the-money put sale favors selling puts on dips or buying strength on the moat thesis.

plays.name: Johnson Controls
plays.title: Calls Bought in Thermal Technology Leader With Record Backlog on Data Center Demand
flow: Johnson Controls (JCI) on 10/26 with a buyer of 2000 December $160 calls at $3.54 in adjustments for around $700K, open interest now 3,500. The same session saw 1600 December $130 short puts open.
JCI also has 700 September 2027 $170 calls bought on 9/16 holding in open interest, and saw 300 September 2027 $145 short puts open on 10/9 and 225 September 2027 $190 calls bought on 10/13.

JCI shares are +30% YTD and have held above the 200 day moving average for more than a year, and after reclaiming the 50 day on Monday shares are back near the $160 October high, resistance for a breakout.
plays.recommendation: JCI is a core way to own data center thermal demand with a record backlog behind it, and like following the December $160 calls into a breakout over the October high.

plays.name: Datadog
plays.title: Bulls Stick with Best in Class AI Infrastructure Services Leader
flow: Datadog (DDOG) last week with opening sales of December $230 puts 800X and December $220 puts 600X and follows a 9/3 opening sale of 500 June 2028 $310 straddles which has a strong bullish bias.
DDOG also has long January 2028 $260 calls in open interest valued near $15M and 2000 December $130 calls worth $34M.

plays.name: Corcept Therapeutics
plays.title: Bull Spread Positions for Upside in Impressive Biotech Growth Story into Catalyst
flow: Corcept Therapeutics (CORT) with a rare large trade on 10/20 as 2560 January $120/$160 wide call spreads bought to open for around $2.8M debit.
CORT still has 4200 January $140/$95 short strangles in open interest from a 9/29 trade and a 5/27 trade bought 1000 January $80 calls and sits on a $4M position up 450%.

plays.name: 3M

plays.name: Coinbase
plays.title: Call Buyers and Put Sellers Position in Crypto Leader Ahead of Earnings
flow: Coinbase (COIN) on 10/19 with an opening sale of 300 September 2027 $150 puts at $26.50 as shares pulled back for a second session. That follows 1500 November $175 short puts opened late in the day on 10/12 at $12.60.
COIN also has 9325 December $185 calls bought at $23 on 10/5 still holding in open interest.

Shares closed above all four of their key moving averages on 10/15 and slipped back below them the next session. COIN is -25.5% YTD and 55% below its 52 week high, with the July low at $139 as key support and the September high near $208 as resistance.

plays.name: Astera Labs
plays.title: Put Sales Accumulate in Hyper Growth Connectivity Winner
flow: Astera Labs (ALAB) on 10/14 with a large opening sale of 600 September 2027 $220 puts at $36.20 and has seen a string of size long-dated put sales into weakness.

ALAB September $200 short puts opened 600X on 10/13 while 500 of the $320 calls bought, March $230 short puts 4000X, March $220 short puts 350X, January $250 short puts 850X, March $280 short puts 500X, January $260 puts 400X and January 2028 $300 short puts have all opened in the last two weeks.
ALAB on the weekly is in a longer-term rising channel pattern and the past six-months a bull pennant forming. On more weakness, monthly lower value and rising 200MA support at $248.5 should hold.

plays.name: Cisco

flow: Cisco (CSCO) on 10/12 with a buyer of 1950 December 2028 $140 calls for $3.8M and also with 1000 March $110 short puts opening.
These bull trades follow size buys in September $135 calls for $2.7M, June $170 way OTM calls 2500X and 2000 December $110 calls, accumulation of bull positioning with 11-12 the next earnings date.
